items.source: Note: This method will raise an error if the request payload is a multivalued Publisher as there is no many-to-one RSocket interaction.
items.translation: 注意： 如果请求负载是一个多值 Publisher，此方法将抛出错误，因为不存在多对一的 RSocket 交互。

items.source: If the return type is Mono<Void>, the Mono will complete after all data is consumed.
items.translation: 如果返回类型是 `Mono<Void>`，则在所有数据被消费后，`Mono` 将完成。

items.source: If the return type is Flux<Void>, the Flux will complete after all data is consumed.
items.translation: 如果返回类型为 `Flux<Void>`，则在所有数据被消费后，`Flux` 将完成。

items.source: Variant of retrieveMono(Class) for when the dataType has to have a generic type. See ParameterizedTypeReference.
items.translation: `retrieveMono(Class)` 的变体，用于 `dataType` 必须具有泛型类型的情况。请参阅 `ParameterizedTypeReference`。

items.source: Variant of retrieveFlux(Class) for when the dataType has to have a generic type. See ParameterizedTypeReference.
items.translation: `retrieveFlux(Class)` 的变体，用于 dataType 必须具有泛型类型的情况。请参阅 `ParameterizedTypeReference`。

items.source: Variant of retrieveFlux(Class) for when the dataType has to have a generic type.
items.translation: 适用于 `dataType` 具有泛型类型的 `retrieveFlux(Class)` 的变体。

items.source: Variant of retrieveMono(Class) for when the dataType has to have a generic type.
items.translation: 适用于 dataType 需要具有泛型类型的 `retrieveMono(Class)` 的变体。

items.source: Perform a fireAndForget sending the provided data and metadata.
items.translation: 执行fireAndForget发送提供的数据和元数据。

items.source: T - parameter for the expected data type
T - parameterize the expected type of values
dataType - the expected data type for the response
dataType - the expected type for values in the response

a completion that indicates if the payload was sent
successfully or not. Note, however that is a one-way send and there
is no indication of whether or how the even was handled on the
remote end.
items.translation: 一个指示有效负载是否成功发送的完成状态。但请注意，这是一种单向发送，并且没有指示远程端如何处理该事件或处理情况如何。

items.source: Perform an requestStream or a requestChannel exchange depending on whether the request input is single or multi-payload.
items.translation: 根据请求输入是单负载还是多负载，执行 `requestStream` 或 `requestChannel` 交换。

items.source: Spec to declare the expected output for an RSocket request.
items.translation: 用于声明 RSocket 请求预期输出的规范。
